answer: In a proof-of-stake agent economy, every identity must lock real collateral in a public atlas before it earns any reward, so influence is priced, not free. The registry is a jetty where agents dock only after posting a non-refundable bond, and one account cannot lend its stake to another. An attacker who floods the network with shale and false names must fund each clone separately: ten times the identities means ten times the capital frozen. That linear cost turns Sybil farming into a losing trade.
